about: Read rules shared by the Go read path (internal/http) and the Worker's worker/src/read.js.
Each vector runs request (path already percent-decoded; raw and files flags) against rows[row] as the Paste cell holds it; null is no row.
extensions is the known-extension table's asset flag: a miss on an asset extension is a 404, any other a route.
entry.decodedSize is the stored entry's DecodedSize, 0 for an entry without one; only a positive one is a response's Content-Length, whatever the entry's Size.

entry.offset and entry.length are present only for a pack member, whose ETag is its key, "@" and its offset. An entry with a digest has the ETag "sha256-" and its digest instead, wherever it is stored.
